Buying Process

From Decision to
Title Deed.

6 clear steps from first inquiry to ownership and residency.

6 Steps
Buying Process in Dubai
1
Define Goal & Budget

Choose between pre-sale — lower price, staged payments, capital growth — or ready property — immediate rental income. Expat mortgage: max 75% LTV.

Pre-sale or Ready · Mortgage or Cash
2
Broker Agreement

Ready: RERA Form B — 2% commission paid by buyer at DLD transfer. Pre-sale: Contract directly with developer — zero broker commission. I guide you for free.

Ready → 2% · Pre-sale → Zero commission
3
Reservation

Pay reservation deposit to hold unit while SPA is prepared: AED 50,000 (entry) · AED 50K–500K (mid) · AED 500K–1M (luxury).

AED 50K–1M reservation
4
SPA & Oqood — Pre-Sale

Pay 20% down + 4% DLD → SPA signed within 20 days–2 months → Oqood registered → apply for residency immediately.

20%+4% → SPA → Oqood → Residency
5
MOU + NOC + Transfer — Ready

Form I (MOU) signed · 10% deposit · NOC from developer (5–15 days) · DLD transfer: 4% fee + AED 4,200 admin · Title Deed same day.

4% DLD · Title Deed same day
6
Residency Application

Golden Visa (10yr): AED 2M+ — spouse, children (no age limit), parents. 2-Year Visa: AED 400K+ — spouse and children (sons up to 21). No sponsor required.

Golden Visa AED 2M+ · 2yr AED 400K+
